item.description:
标签: #上下文窗口 #显存瓶颈 #大模型

摘要: 尽管Anthropic近日正式发布百万级上下文窗口模型，但文章指出过去两年该指标几乎停滞（自2024年Gemini首创以来增长不足一个数量级），核心瓶颈在于推理端HBM/DRAM内存的物理短缺；作者预测未来5-10年上下文窗口难以突破百万级别，行业可能被迫进入"上下文配给"时代。

[AINews] Context Drought（上下文枯竭）

Anthropic is rightfully being celebrated today for releasing their 1M context models in GA, with SOTA MRCR results that fight Context Rot for as long as possible:

Anthropic 今日发布 1M 上下文模型（100万token上下文窗口）并全面开放（GA），在 MRCR（多针检索上下文召回，Multi-needle Retrieval for Context Recall）基准测试中取得了 SOTA（State of the Art，最先进水平）成绩，尽可能延缓了 Context Rot（上下文衰减/退化），这确实值得庆贺：

Very useful and any default model that pushes back the compaction dumb zone for longer is welcome, but we are still remembering that the 1M context window was GA in March 2024, after Gemini did it in Feb 2024, and GAing after OpenAI GA'ed theirs last week.

任何能将 压缩盲区（compaction dumb zone，指模型因上下文过长而性能急剧下降的区域）推后更长时间的默认模型都非常实用且受欢迎，但我们仍需记住，1M 上下文窗口早在 2024 年 3 月就已 GA（Gemini 于 2024 年 2 月率先实现），而 OpenAI 也在上周全面开放了他们的 1M 上下文模型。

It's been 2 whole years since 1M context windows were theoretically possible, which means just under 1 order of magnitude growth in 2 years in context windows, which is much slower growth than all other dimensions (cost/speed/quality) of LLMs. We're thinking back to Sam Altman's Town Hall where he said context windows would get 100x longer… and we would take the under on that.

从理论上实现 1M 上下文窗口至今已经过去了整整两年，这意味着上下文窗口在两年内增长还不到一个数量级，远慢于 LLM（大型语言模型）在其他维度（成本/速度/质量）上的发展速度。我们回想起 Sam Altman 在市政厅会议上曾表示上下文窗口将延长 100 倍……而我们对此持悲观态度（take the under，赌不会实现）。

The issue lies in the global memory shortage - there's just no HBM, or even DRAM, to take in all of this context at the inference site. Our podcast with Doug O'Laughlin covers this in greater detail:

问题在于全球内存短缺——推理端根本没有足够的 HBM（高带宽内存，High Bandwidth Memory），甚至连 DRAM（动态随机存取存储器）都不足以容纳所有这些上下文。我们与 Doug O'Laughlin 的播客对此有更详细的讨论：

swyx: One thing I, I do tell people about is everyone, including Sam by the way, is like predicting longer context windows. We've been effectively stuck at a million for two years now. I've actually been thinking about that a lot. And like, this is not gonna go to a hundred million context windows. It's not gonna go to trillion. Like, we're this is it? Yeah. This is it for like five years, 10 years pretty much.

[01:45:48] Doug: Yeah, probably actually. Will capitalism work? Will there be a way for supply to show up? Probably. But on top of that, you have to make a curve of the context windows. Like does free context windows go to like 1000? Hey, you can use chatGPT free now, but your context window is like a thousand tokens or something like that. And then you can just like somehow do a tiny parcel for that just so that you can then charge 100x more for 1 million. The 1 million context window is like a mansion, you know?

[01:46:27] swyx: Oh my God. The word just context rationing just came to me. I'm like, fuck. Like we're gonna have like vouchers for like, okay, you can have this amount of context today. I think for me, what matters is you represent the physical constraints that us, the software side can never surmount.

[01:47:43] Because it's a physical constraint and Well, I mean, it just, it just like, physically we cannot double, we can't even, we can't even double and much unless says 10x.

[01:47:53] Doug: Context rationing. It's pretty good. Context frugality or budget or something. I feel like everyone's gonna be like, whoa, you're running outta context window today. Maybe that's what happens next year.

swyx： 有一件事我确实会告诉人们的，就是所有人——顺便包括 Sam——都在预测更长的上下文窗口。但我们实际上在 100 万（token）上已经卡了两年。我确实经常思考这个问题。而且，这不会发展到 1 亿上下文窗口，也不会到万亿。就像，就这样了？是的，大概未来五年、十年就是这样了。

[01:45:48] Doug： 是的，实际上很可能。资本主义会起作用吗？会有供应出现的方式吗？可能会。但除此之外，你必须构建上下文窗口的曲线。比如免费版的上下文窗口会不会降到 1000？嘿，你现在可以免费使用 ChatGPT，但你的上下文窗口只有一千个 token 左右。然后你可以对这部分做极小的分割，这样你就可以对 100 万上下文窗口收取 100 倍的费用。100 万上下文窗口就像一座豪宅，你知道吗？

[01:46:27] swyx： 我的天。刚刚想到了"上下文配给"（context rationing）这个词。我去。就像我们会发券，比如，你今天只能用这么多上下文。对我来说，重要的是你代表了物理约束，这是我们软件端永远无法克服的。

[01:47:43] 因为这是物理约束，而且，我的意思是，就是，物理上我们无法翻倍，我们甚至无法翻倍，更不用说 10 倍了。

[01:47:53] Doug： 上下文配给。这词很好。上下文节俭或预算之类的。我觉得每个人都会说，哇，你今天快用完上下文窗口了。也许明年就会发生这种情况。

Mark our words, people. Willing to bet that context windows do not meaningfully go higher than 1M in the next 2 years, which is a big bet to make in AI time.

记住我们的话。我们愿意打赌，在未来两年内，上下文窗口不会有意义地超过 100 万，这在 AI 时间尺度上是一个很大的赌注。

AI Twitter Recap（AI Twitter 回顾）

Agent Infrastructure, MCP Friction, and Persistent Memory（智能体基础设施、MCP 摩擦与持久化记忆）

The MCP backlash is mostly about ergonomics, not demand: A good slice of the feed was engineers arguing over whether MCP is "dead" or simply over-exposed. @pamelafox joked that "MCP was pronounced dead on Twitter, after mass exposure to curl," while @tadasayy countered that usage is still booming. The more substantive take came from @llama_index: MCP tools are strong when you need deterministic, centrally maintained APIs and rapidly changing ground truth; skills are lighter-weight local natural-language procedures but more failure-prone. Relatedly, @bromann pointed to new web MCP support in Chrome v146, showing a LangChain Deep Agent that continuously browses X and compiles a daily summary.

对 MCP（模型上下文协议，Model Context Protocol）的反对主要关于人机工程学（ergonomics），而非需求：信息流中很大一部分是工程师在争论 MCP 是否"已死"或只是过度曝光。@pamelafox 开玩笑说："在大量暴露于 curl 之后，MCP 在 Twitter 上被宣布死亡"，而 @tadasayy 反驳说使用量仍在激增。更有实质性的观点来自 @llama_index：MCP 工具在你需要确定性、集中维护的 API 和快速变化的真实数据（ground truth）时很强大；而 skills（技能）是更轻量级的本地自然语言程序，但更容易失败。相关地，@bromann 指出了 Chrome v146 中新的 Web MCP 支持，展示了一个 LangChain 深度智能体持续浏览 X 并编译每日摘要。

Memory is becoming the differentiator for agents: The most technically interesting agent thread was around persistent memory and self-improvement. @dair_ai highlighted IBM work on extracting reusable strategy/recovery/optimization tips from agent trajectories, improving AppWorld task completion from 69.6% to 73.2% and scenario goals from 50.0% to 64.3%, with the biggest gains on hard tasks. In parallel, @omarsar0 summarized a paper reframing multi-agent memory as a computer architecture problem, with cache/memory hierarchy, coherence, and access-control issues rather than "just more context." This maps directly onto product work like Hermes Agent, which multiple tweets described as a self-hostable agent that retains skills and user-specific memory over time (overview via @abxxai, demo via @Teknium).

记忆正在成为智能体的差异化因素：技术上最有趣的智能体讨论围绕 持久化记忆（persistent memory）和自我改进。@dair_ai 强调了 IBM 从智能体轨迹中提取可重用的策略/恢复/优化提示的工作，将 AppWorld 的 任务完成率从 69.6% 提高到 73.2%，场景目标完成率从 50.0% 提高到 64.3%，在困难任务上提升最大。与此同时，@omarsar0 总结了一篇将多智能体记忆重构为 计算机架构问题的论文，涉及缓存/内存层次结构、一致性（coherence）和访问控制问题，而非"只是更多上下文"。这直接对应到如 Hermes Agent 等产品工作，多条推文将其描述为可自托管的智能体，能够随时间保留技能和用户特定记忆（概述 via @abxxai，演示 via @Teknium）。

Agent UX is moving to always-on, cross-device operation: Several launches pushed agents closer to "personal computer as orchestrator." Perplexity Computer rolled out to iOS with cross-device synchronization, letting users start or manage a browser-computer task from phone or desktop (announcement, Arav follow-up). @bcherny showed the analogous flow for Claude Code, starting sessions on a laptop from a phone. Genspark's Claw was framed similarly as an "AI employee" with a persistent cloud computer (summary by @kimmonismus). The common pattern: persistent session state, remote execution, and orchestration across many models/tools.

智能体用户体验正转向始终在线、跨设备操作：多个发布推动智能体更接近"个人电脑作为编排器"。Perplexity Computer 推出 iOS 版并支持跨设备同步，允许用户从手机或桌面启动或管理浏览器-计算机任务（公告、Arav 跟进）。@bcherny 展示了 Claude Code 的类似流程，通过手机在笔记本电脑上启动会话。Genspark 的 Claw 被类似地定位为具有持久云计算机的"AI 员工"（@kimmonismus 总结）。共同模式是：持久化会话状态、远程执行和跨多模型/工具的编排。

Inference, Long Context, and Systems Performance（推理、长上下文与系统性能）

Anthropic quietly shipped one of the bigger infra-relevant updates of the week: Opus 4.6 1M context became the default for Max/Team/Enterprise users (via @_catwu), and Anthropic removed the API's extra charge for long context while also dropping the beta header requirement and expanding media limits to 600 images/PDF pages per request (details from @alexalbert__). The most notable metric attached was 78.3% on MRCR v2 at 1M tokens, called out by multiple observers as a new frontier long-context high watermark (e.g. @kimmonismus).

Anthropic 悄然发布了本周与基础设施相关的重要更新之一：Opus 4.6 1M 上下文成为 Max/Team/Enterprise 用户的默认选项（via @_catwu），Anthropic 还取消了 API 对长上下文的额外收费，同时移除了 beta 标头要求，并将媒体限制扩展到每请求 600 张图片/PDF 页（详情来自 @alexalbert__）。最引人注目的指标是在 100 万 token 下 MRCR v2 达到 78.3%，被多位观察者称为新的前沿长上下文高水位线（如 @kimmonismus）。

Sparse attention optimization is still yielding meaningful wins: A standout systems thread from @realYushiBai introduced IndexCache, which reuses sparse-attention index information across layers in DeepSeek Sparse Attention. Reported gains: roughly 1.2× end-to-end speedup on GLM-5 (744B) with matching quality, and on a 30B-scale experimental model at 200K context, 1.82× prefill and 1.48× decode after removing 75% of indexers. This was notable because it targets a production-scale sparse-attention stack with "minimal code change," which is exactly the kind of practical optimization labs care about now.

稀疏注意力（Sparse attention）优化仍在带来有意义的收益：@realYushiBai 的一个杰出系统线程介绍了 IndexCache，它在 DeepSeek 稀疏注意力中跨层复用稀疏注意力索引信息。报告的增益：在 GLM-5 (744B) 上约 1.2 倍端到端加速且质量匹配，在 30B 规模实验模型的 200K 上下文下，移除 75% 的索引器后，预填充（prefill）加速 1.82 倍，解码（decode）加速 1.48 倍。这值得注意是因为它针对生产规模的稀疏注意力堆栈，只需"最少代码更改"，这正是实验室现在关心的实用优化类型。

KV/cache and serving optimizations are broadening beyond autoregressive LLMs: @RisingSayak highlighted Black Forest Labs' Klein KV, which injects cached reference-image KVs into later DiT denoising steps for multi-reference editing, claiming up to 2.5× speedups. On the infra side, @satyanadella said Microsoft is the first cloud validating an NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 system, while @LambdaAPI pushed the "bare metal over hypervisor" angle for Rubin-era clusters. @tinygrad added a more radical endpoint: an "exabox" exposed as a single giant Python-driven GPU in 2027.

KV/缓存（Key-Value cache，键值缓存）和服务优化正扩展到自回归 LLM 之外：@RisingSayak 强调了 Black Forest Labs 的 Klein KV，它将缓存的参考图像 KV 注入到后续的 DiT（扩散 Transformer，Diffusion Transformer）去噪步骤中用于多参考编辑，声称可达 2.5 倍加速。在基础设施方面，@satyanadella 表示 Microsoft 是首个验证 NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 系统的云厂商，而 @LambdaAPI 推动了 Rubin 时代集群的"裸金属优于虚拟机监控程序"（bare metal over hypervisor）角度。@tinygrad 添加了一个更激进的端点：到 2027 年，一个"exabox"将作为单个巨型 Python 驱动 GPU 呈现。

Post-Training, RL Alternatives, and Evaluation Research（后训练、强化学习替代方案与评估研究）

A provocative post-training result: random Gaussian search can rival RL fine-tuning: The most-discussed research claim was RandOpt / Neural Thickets from MIT-adjacent authors, shared by @yule_gan and @phillip_isola. The claim: by adding Gaussian noise to pretrained model weights and ensembling, one can reach performance comparable to or better than GRPO/PPO on reasoning, coding, writing, chemistry, and VLM tasks. Their explanation is that large pretrained models live in local neighborhoods dense with useful task specialists—"neural thickets"—making post-training much easier than standard optimization intuitions suggest.

一个挑衅性的后训练结果：随机高斯搜索可与 RL 微调相媲美：最受讨论的研究主张是 MIT 相关作者提出的 RandOpt / Neural Thickets（神经灌木丛），由 @yule_gan 和 @phillip_isola 分享。该主张：通过向预训练模型权重添加高斯噪声并进行集成，可以在推理、编码、写作、化学和 VLM（视觉语言模型）任务上达到与 GRPO/PPO（群组相对策略优化/近端策略优化，Group Relative Policy Optimization / Proximal Policy Optimization）相当或更好的性能。他们的解释是，大型预训练模型存在于充满有用任务专家的局部邻域中——"神经灌木丛"——这使得后训练比标准优化直觉所暗示的要容易得多。

Generic-data replay and pre-pre-training are getting renewed attention: @TheTuringPost summarized Stanford work on generic data replay, reporting 1.87× improvement during fine-tuning and 2.06× during mid-training, with concrete downstream gains like +4.5% on agentic web navigation and +2% on Basque QA. Separate chatter around "pre-pre-training" suggested the community is revisiting staging/mixture design earlier in the training pipeline, not just post-training tricks (commentary from @teortaxesTex).

通用数据回放（generic-data replay）和预-预训练（pre-pre-training）正重新获得关注：@TheTuringPost 总结了斯坦福关于 通用数据回放的工作，报告在微调期间有 1.87 倍改进，在中期训练（mid-training）期间有 2.06 倍改进，在下游任务上有具体收益，如智能体网页导航提升 4.5%，巴斯克语 QA 提升 2%。关于"预-预训练"的单独讨论表明，社区正在重新审视训练流程早期的分阶段/混合设计，而不仅仅是后训练技巧（评论来自 @teortaxesTex）。

Evaluation remains a bottleneck, especially for truthfulness and search strategy: @ishared BrokenArXiv, where even GPT-5.4 rejected only 40% of perturbed false mathematical statements from recent papers. @paul_cal argued this gives GPT-5.4 an edge over Claude on proof-verification-style "bullshit detection," even if other truthfulness benchmarks disagree. For retrieval/search, MADQA found agents near human answer accuracy by using brute-force search rather than strategic navigation over documents, leaving about a 20% gap to oracle performance (via @HuggingPapers).

评估仍然是瓶颈，特别是在真实性和搜索策略方面：@ishared 分享了 BrokenArXiv，即使是 GPT-5.4 也只拒绝了近期论文中 40% 的扰动错误数学陈述。@paul_cal 认为这使 GPT-5.4 在证明验证风格的"胡说八道检测"上比 Claude 更具优势，即使其他真实性基准测试结果不同。对于检索/搜索，MADQA 发现智能体通过暴力搜索而非对文档的策略性导航就能接近人类回答准确率，距离 oracle 性能仍有约 20% 的差距（via @HuggingPapers）。

Open Source Releases, Datasets, and Reproducibility（开源发布、数据集与可复现性）

OpenFold3's new preview is unusually complete by frontier biology standards: @MoAlQuraishi announced OpenFold3 preview 2, saying it closes much of the gap to AlphaFold3 across modalities while releasing not just weights but also training sets and configs, making it "the only current AF3-based model that is functionally trainable & reproducible from scratch." That reproducibility claim is the key point: many "open" biology releases still stop well short of end-to-end re-trainability.

OpenFold3 的新预览版在前沿生物学标准下异常完整：@MoAlQuraishi 宣布了 OpenFold3 preview 2，称它在跨模态上缩小了与 AlphaFold3 的差距，同时发布的不仅是权重，还有 训练集和配置，使其成为"目前唯一基于 AF3 且功能上可从零训练并复现的模型"。这一可复现性主张是关键点：许多"开放"的生物学发布在端到端可重训练性方面仍远未达标。

Speech data for underrepresented languages got a meaningful boost: @osanseviero announced WAXAL, an open multilingual speech dataset covering 17 African languages for TTS and 19 for ASR, later described by @GoogleResearch as 2,400+ hours spanning 27 Sub-Saharan languages and 100M+ speakers. The exact language/task counts differed between posts, but both positioned WAXAL as a rare, community-rooted resource for African voice AI.

代表性不足语言的语音数据得到了有意义的提升：@osanseviero 宣布了 WAXAL，一个开源多语言语音数据集，涵盖 17 种非洲语言的 TTS（文本转语音，Text-to-Speech）和 19 种语言的 ASR（自动语音识别，Automatic Speech Recognition），@GoogleResearch 后来描述其为跨越 27 种撒哈拉以南非洲语言、超过 1 亿使用者的 2400 多小时音频。帖子间的具体语言/任务数量有所不同，但两者都将 WAXAL 定位为非洲语音 AI 领域罕见的、根植于社区的资源。

Open-source sentiment around training data is hardening in favor of permissive reuse: The strongest statement came from @ID_AA_Carmack, who argued that open-source code is a gift whose value is magnified by AI training, not undermined by it. @giffmana and @perrymetzger echoed that view. The most nuanced counterpoint was @wightmanr, who argued that coding agents may bypass attribution and licensing expectations in ways that could demotivate maintainers, suggesting a protocol for agent compliance could become important.

关于训练数据的开源情绪正趋向支持宽松重用：最强烈的声明来自 @ID_AA_Carmack，他认为开源代码是一份礼物，其价值因 AI 训练而 放大，而非被削弱。@giffmana 和 @perrymetzger 呼应了这一观点。最微妙的反驳来自 @wightmanr，他认为编码智能体可能以绕过归属和许可期望的方式行事，这可能会打击维护者的积极性，暗示智能体合规协议可能变得重要。

Developer Tooling, Coding Agents, and Research Automation（开发者工具、编码智能体与研究自动化）

Coding-agent workflows are getting more autonomous and more opinionated: There were many examples of engineers moving from "copilot" to multi-agent software factories. @matvelloso described a setup with 5 agents doing code review/test/security/perf work and 2 more merging PRs and running regression checks. @swyx compressed the trend to "Your Code is your Infra," while @gokulr and @matanSF pointed to FactoryAI as an increasingly common "software factory" layer.

编码智能体工作流正变得更加自主和固执己见：有许多工程师从"copilot"（副驾驶）转向 多智能体软件工厂（multi-agent software factories）的例子。@matvelloso 描述了一个设置，其中 5 个智能体负责代码审查/测试/安全/性能工作，另外 2 个合并 PR 并运行回归检查。@swyx 将这一趋势概括为"Your Code is your Infra"（你的代码就是你的基础设施），而 @gokulr 和 @matanSF 指出 FactoryAI 正成为越来越常见的"软件工厂"层。

Autonomous research is becoming a product category, but not a new idea: Karpathy's autoresearch and related hackathons drew significant attention, but several tweets noted the conceptual overlap with older systems like DSPy, GEPA, and Bayesian optimization pipelines. The most practical pointer was @dbreunig recommending optimize_anything for people interested in this style of iterative self-improvement. Together AI also shipped Open Deep Research v2, open-sourcing its app, eval dataset, code, and blog (launch).

自主研究（Autonomous research）正成为一个产品类别，但并非新概念：Karpathy 的 autoresearch 及相关黑客马拉松吸引了大量关注，但多条推文指出其与旧系统如 DSPy、GEPA 和贝叶斯优化流程在概念上存在重叠。最实用的指引是 @dbreunig 推荐 optimize_anything 给对这种迭代自我改进风格感兴趣的人。Together AI 也发布了 Open Deep Research v2，开源了其应用、评估数据集、代码和博客（发布）。

War in Iran

Iran has begun to attack ships passing through the Strait of Hormuz; in normal times the strait carries about 3000 ships per month, including a large number of oil tankers. Roughly 20% of the world's oil — around 20 million barrels of oil per day — passes through the Strait of Hormuz. This has effectively shut down traffic through the strait, because insurance companies have withdrawn coverage. Via Shanaka Anslem Perera on Substack:

伊朗已开始袭击通过霍尔木兹海峡（Strait of Hormuz）的船只；正常情况下，该海峡每月约有3000艘船只通过，其中包括大量油轮（oil tankers）。全球约20%的石油——每天约2000万桶——经过霍尔木兹海峡。这实际上已经关闭了海峡的通行，因为保险（insurance）公司已经撤回了承保。via Shanaka Anslem Perera on Substack：

At midnight Greenwich Mean Time on 5 March 2026, seven of the twelve International Group Protection and Indemnity clubs that collectively insure roughly 90% of the world's ocean-going tonnage executed identical cancellation notices for war-risk coverage across the Persian Gulf, the Gulf of Oman, and Iranian territorial waters.Gard, NorthStandard, Skuld, Steamship Mutual, the American Club, the Swedish Club, and the London P&I Club withdrew coverage. They did not act because a government ordered them to. They did not act because a naval commander declared a blockade. They did not act because a single mine had been laid in the shipping channel. They withdrew because their London treaty reinsurers, confronting unlimited tail exposure in an active combat zone, could no longer satisfy the 99.5% Value-at-Risk capital charges mandated by the European Union's Solvency II directive. The reinsurers pulled capacity. The clubs, which operate as mutuals whose losses fall directly on member shipowners, had no mathematical alternative.

2026年3月5日格林威治标准时间午夜，十二家国际集团保赔协会（International Group Protection and Indemnity clubs）中的七家——它们共同承保了全球约90%的远洋吨位——对波斯湾、阿曼湾和伊朗领海的战争风险保险（war-risk coverage）发布了相同的取消通知。Gard、NorthStandard、Skuld、Steamship Mutual、American Club、Swedish Club 和 London P&I Club 撤回了承保。它们这样做并非因为政府命令，也不是因为海军指挥官宣布封锁，更不是因为航道中布设了水雷。它们撤回是因为其伦敦条约再保险公司（reinsurers）在面对活跃战区的无限尾部风险时，已无法满足欧盟 Solvency II 指令规定的99.5%风险价值（Value-at-Risk）资本要求。再保险公司撤出了承保能力。这些以互保形式运营、损失直接由成员船东承担的保赔协会别无选择。

来自 NBC 的报道：

Even in peacetime, the world of shipping is a bureaucratic labyrinth of captains, owners, brokers and insurers. To try and reduce oil prices, the Trump Administration plans to suspend the Jones Act, which requires goods carried between US ports to be carried on US built ships.

为试图降低油价，特朗普政府（Trump Administration）计划暂停《琼斯法案》（Jones Act），该法案要求在美国港口之间运输的货物必须由美国建造的船舶承运。

标签: #智能体工程 #AI编程 #编程代理

摘要: 作者在Pragmatic Summit的炉边谈话中探讨了智能体工程（Agentic Engineering）的演进与实践，分析了AI编程工具从辅助问答到自主编码代理的发展阶段，强调通过测试驱动开发、沙盒安全和代码模板来有效利用AI。文章还讨论了提示注入等安全风险、代码质量的新标准，以及开发者应如何借助AI技术提升工程能力并探索更雄心勃勃的项目。

原标题: My fireside chat about agentic engineering at the Pragmatic Summit

I was a speaker last month at the Pragmatic Summit in San Francisco, where I participated in a fireside chat session about Agentic Engineering (智能体工程) hosted by Eric Lui from Statsig. The video is available on YouTube. Here are my highlights from the conversation.

我上个月在旧金山的 Pragmatic Summit 上担任演讲嘉宾，参加了由 Statsig 的 Eric Lui 主持的关于Agentic Engineering（智能体工程）的炉边谈话。视频已在 YouTube 上发布。以下是我从对话中整理出的要点。

Stages of AI adoption

We started by talking about the different phases a software developer goes through in adopting AI coding tools (AI 编程工具).

我们首先讨论了软件开发者在采用 AI coding tools（AI 编程工具）时所经历的不同阶段。

02:45

I feel like there are different stages of AI adoption as a programmer. You start off with you've got ChatGPT and you ask it questions and occasionally it helps you out. And then the big step is when you move to the coding agents (编码智能体) that are writing code for you—initially writing bits of code and then there's that moment where the agent writes more code than you do, which is a big moment. And that for me happened only about maybe six months ago.

我觉得作为程序员，AI 的采用有不同的阶段。一开始你使用 ChatGPT，向它提问，偶尔它会帮到你。然后是一大飞跃，当你开始使用为你写代码的coding agents（编码智能体）时——最初只是写一些代码片段，然后会有那么一个时刻，智能体写的代码比你写的还多，这是一个重要时刻。对我来说，这大约只发生在六个月前。

Trusting AI output

We discussed the challenge of knowing when to trust the AI's output as opposed to reviewing every line with a fine tooth-comb.

我们讨论了如何决定何时应该信任 AI 的输出，而不是逐行仔细审查的挑战。

The way I've become a little bit more comfortable with it is thinking about how when I worked at a big company, other teams would build services for us and we would read their documentation, use their service, and we wouldn't go and look at their code. If it broke, we'd dive in and see what the bug was in the code. But you generally trust those teams of professionals to produce stuff that works. Trusting an AI in the same way feels very uncomfortable. I think Opus 4.5 was the first one that earned my trust—I'm very confident now that for classes of problems that I've seen it tackle before, it's not going to do anything stupid. If I ask it to build a JSON API that hits this database and returns the data and paginates it, it's just going to do it and I'm going to get the right thing back.

All of the good coding agents know what red-green TDD is and they will start churning through and the chances of you getting code that works go up so much if they're writing the test first.

摘要: Jannis Leidel指出，GitHub上AI生成垃圾PR的泛滥已使Jazzband的开放成员与共享推送权限模式难以为继；在AI生成内容质量低劣、甚至迫使GitHub推出"禁用PR"功能的当下，赋予所有加入者推送权限的协作方式已不再安全。

原标题: Quoting Jannis Leidel

Quoting Jannis Leidel

GitHub’s slopocalypse– the flood of AI-generated spam PRs and issues – has made Jazzband’s model of open membership and shared push access untenable. Jazzband was designed for a world where the worst case was someone accidentally merging the wrong PR (Pull Request). In a world where only 1 in 10 AI-generated PRs meets project standards, where curl had to shut down its bug bounty because confirmation rates dropped below 5%, and where GitHub’s own response was a kill switch to disable pull requests entirely– an organization that gives push access to everyone who joins simply can’t operate safely anymore.

GitHub 的"slopocalypse（垃圾内容末日）"——即 AI-generated spam PRs（AI 生成的垃圾拉取请求）和 Issue（问题）的泛滥——使得 Jazzband 的open membership（开放会员制）和共享推送权限模式变得难以为继。

Jazzband 的设计初衷是基于一个最坏情况不过是有人意外合并了错误 PR（Pull Request，拉取请求）的世界。而在一个只有十分之一的 AI 生成 PR 能达到项目标准、curl 项目被迫关闭其 bug bounty（漏洞赏金计划）因为确认率跌破 5%、以及 GitHub 自身的应对措施竟是彻底禁用拉取请求的kill switch（紧急开关）的世界里——一个向所有加入者开放推送权限的组织根本无法安全运作了。
